info.title: Vegetable Joint REST API
info.description: API specification for Vegetable Joint marketplace, connecting vegetable sellers with buyers in Nigeria. Conforms to SRS Section 4.4, Section 5, IF-01 to IF-06, and NFR-MAIN-05.

post.summary: Register a new buyer or seller account
post.description: Registers a new user (buyer or seller). Admin role cannot be self-registered (SRS AUTH-01, AUTH-02, 4.4).

post.summary: Authenticate user with email and password
post.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns session token and profile (SRS AUTH-04, 4.4).

429.description: Too many requests / rate limited (SRS NFR-SEC-07)

post.description: Logs out user and invalidates current authentication token (SRS AUTH-05, NFR-SEC-03).
